title: Techno India University to host School of Future, in collaboration with IBM and Google
description: Techno India University has collaborated with Google and IBM to form a School of Future, with an aim to create a global ecosystem for digital skills and futuristic technologies.

title: Techno India University, West Bengal and Google Cloud India Sign MoU to Transform Digital Education
description: Kolkata, 21st May 2024: Techno India University, West Bengal, has entered into a strategic partnership with Google Cloud India by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to revolutionize digital education and skill development in the region.
